name: Resolve company domains to LinkedIn company records with Apify

parameters.content:
## Who is it for?
Sales operations teams and research agencies that have company website domains and want structured company records for CRM review.

## How it works
The workflow submits 1-10 domains to the LinkedIn Company by Domain actor on Apify, polls every 15 seconds, and retrieves the completed dataset. It retains unresolved rows and adds a needsReview flag for low confidence or missing company links. Failed runs, empty datasets, and polling expiry stop with visible errors. This workflow researches companies; it does not return individual employee profiles or email addresses.

## Setup and requirements
Use n8n and your own Apify account. Create a Header Auth credential with header name Authorization and value Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN. Select it on Start actor, Get run status, and Get company rows. Edit the sample domains in Prepare domains, then execute manually.

Actor usage is billed to your Apify account. The starter caps actor charges at $0.10, uses a 900-second actor timeout, and limits polling to 17 minutes. Check current pricing; the cap can produce partial results. Review domain coverage and rows marked needsReview.

## Customize
Export the final results as CSV, or connect a spreadsheet destination with your own credentials. Setup and verification details: https://the-ai-entrepreneur-ai-hub.github.io/apify-company-research-workflows/

Maintained by the developer of the linked actor.
